Leah: Quick heads-up 10: Nexus Gateway + Redwood pilot kickoff tomorrow. Putting key asks here so partner PM and Eng can prep. Can we confirm owners for auth, manifest, and smoke tests? :hand:

Diego: I'll own auth samples. Nexus prefers OAuth2 for end-users but needs a service account flow for marketplace publishing. I'll draft both snippets and a short security note.

Priya: I'll build the smoke-test matrix: connectivity, function-call roundtrip, embedding sanity (small corpus), and rate-limit behavior. Will run on our staging infra.

Jamal: Two quick clarifications: 1) Function-calling size limits? 2) Any routing header we need to support?

Diego: Function-calling: recommend <=64KB JSON payload for typed tool responses. We'll provide an example and a fallback example for streaming chunked responses. Routing: support `x-rd-route: hosted|dedicated` header; default to hosted and fall back to small-model hosted variant on capacity issues.

Priya: I can add retry/backoff guidance for 429s (use `Retry-After`) and a small test that simulates transient throttling.

Leah: Great. Timeline: Diego (auth snippets) EOD today, Priya (test harness) by tomorrow AM, Jamal to own partner handshake doc with Nexus PM by tomorrow PM.

ci-bot: CI test nexus-gateway-adapter #58 passed on staging (1768889295). Smoke tests queued. :white_check_mark:

Leah: I'll compile the onboarding packet once snippets and tests are in. Pls drop links here when ready. Thanks! :pray:
